preamble.title: Regulated Assets
preamble.author: Tomer Weller <@tomerweller>, Howard Chen <@howardtw>, Christian Peters (DSTOQ) <@shredding>, Leigh McCulloch <@leighmcculloch>

summary: Regulated Assets are assets that require an issuer’s approval (or a delegated third party’s approval, such as a licensed securities exchange) on a per-transaction basis. It standardizes the identification of such assets as well as defines the protocol for performing compliance checks and requesting issuer approval.

fields.name: tx_approve
fields.description: POST /tx_approve - Approval server endpoint that receives a signed transaction, checks for compliance, and signs it on success

fields.name: tx
fields.description: A base64 encoded transaction envelope XDR signed by the user. This is the transaction that will be tested for compliance and signed on success.

fields.name: success
fields.description: Transaction was found compliant and signed without being revised

fields.name: revised
fields.description: Transaction was revised to be made compliant

fields.name: pending
fields.description: Issuer could not determine whether to approve the transaction at the time of receiving it

fields.name: action_required
fields.description: User must complete an action before this transaction can be approved

fields.name: rejected
fields.description: Transaction is not compliant and could not be revised to be made compliant

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status value "success"

fields.name: tx
fields.description: Transaction envelope XDR, base64 encoded. This transaction will have both the original signature(s) from the request as well as one or multiple additional signatures from the issuer.

fields.name: message
fields.description: A human readable string containing information to pass on to the user

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status value "revised"

fields.name: tx
fields.description: Transaction envelope XDR, base64 encoded. This transaction is a revised compliant version of the original request transaction, signed by the issuer.

fields.name: message
fields.description: A human readable string explaining the modifications made to the transaction to make it compliant

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status value "pending"

fields.name: timeout
fields.description: Number of milliseconds to wait before submitting the same transaction again. Use 0 if the wait time cannot be determined.

fields.name: message
fields.description: A human readable string containing information to pass on to the user

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status value "action_required"

fields.name: message
fields.description: A human readable string containing information regarding the action required

fields.name: action_url
fields.description: A URL that allows the user to complete the actions required to have the transaction approved

fields.name: action_method
fields.description: GET or POST, indicating the type of request that should be made to the action_url. If not provided, GET is assumed.

fields.name: action_fields
fields.description: An array of additional fields defined by SEP-9 Standard KYC / AML fields that the client may optionally provide to the approval service when sending the request to the action_url

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status value "rejected"

fields.name: error
fields.description: A human readable string explaining why the transaction is not compliant and could not be made compliant

fields.name: action_url_get
fields.description: Support for GET method to action_url with query parameters

fields.name: action_url_post
fields.description: Support for POST method to action_url with JSON body

fields.name: action_url_post_response_no_further_action
fields.description: Handle POST response with result "no_further_action_required"

fields.name: action_url_post_response_follow_next_url
fields.description: Handle POST response with result "follow_next_url" and next_url field

fields.name: regulated
fields.description: A boolean indicating whether or not this is a regulated asset. If missing, false is assumed.

fields.name: approval_server
fields.description: The URL of an approval service that signs validated transactions

fields.name: approval_criteria
fields.description: A human readable string that explains the issuer's requirements for approving transactions

fields.name: authorization_required
fields.description: Authorization Required flag must be set on issuer account

fields.name: authorization_revocable
fields.description: Authorization Revocable flag must be set on issuer account
